meta.note: All facts from witcher.fandom.com wikitext fetched through api.php?action=parse (quest pages + Gwent players + Isle of Mists cutoff list + patch pages). journal_names_2.json used for file mapping; some mapped files live in journal_names_1/3 (stated per entry). Region: Novigrad + Oxenfurt.
isle_of_mists_cutoff_novigrad: A Matter of Life and Death

region_order: Prereq (any region order is allowed by the wiki for Act I): finish Imperial Audience; Velen/Novigrad/Skellige Act I main quests can be interleaved, but everything below must be done before boarding the boat for The Isle of Mists.
Pyres of Novigrad (L10) - entry quest; unlocks High Stakes, Witch Hunter Raids, Suspicious Shakedown, The Nobleman Statuette.
Novigrad Dreaming (L7) - let Sarah stay so Haunted House exists.

Early Novigrad one-offs while low level: Witch Hunter Raids (gone after Now or Never), Hey You Wanna Look at My Stuff?, Never Trust Children -> Hidden Messages of the Nilfgaardian Kind, Gwent: Playing Innkeeps (Olivier before Now or Never), Gwent: Big City Players (Vivaldi/Serenity only AFTER you have met Sigi Reuven to avoid the auto-complete bug), Contract: An Elusive Thief (after Racists of Novigrad), Contract: The White Lady/Apiarian Phantom/Deadly Delights.
Broken Flowers (L11) - win BOTH Rosa duels (Fencing Lessons), play Zoltan at Gwent here (starts Gwent: Old Pals), ask Zoltan about the women first.
Fencing Lessons part 1 (L12) - right after Broken Flowers; fails at the Isle of Mists.

Get Junior (L12): visit Cleaver first -> The Gangs of Novigrad (arena/casino) BEFORE the Redanian contact; free the halfling (Honor Among Thieves); ask Dijkstra about Dandelion (unlocks Count Reuven's Treasure); finish with Ciri's Story: Visiting Junior, then talk to Radovid's soldiers (A Favor for Radovid) - never fast travel out of the compound.
A Walk on the Waterfront (L12) - before the witch-hunter outpost section of Count Reuven's Treasure.
Count Reuven's Treasure (L12) - ask Menge about Dijkstra's treasure (Brothers In Arms purse).

A Matter of Life and Death (L12) - win all 3 Vegelbud Gwent players (3 unique cards + Dandelion card); rescue Moritz at Glory Gate only before Now or Never. Do this before Carnal Sins' Vegelbud section, or finish that section first, otherwise the ball is postponed.
The Play's the Thing (L11) -> A Poet Under Pressure (L13) (-> Ciri's Story: Breakneck Speed). Play needs both Get Junior and Count Reuven's Treasure.
A Dangerous Game (L12) - steal the Jade figurine from Caesar Bilzen's cupboard (only chance for The Soldier Statuette). Must be finished before you ask Zoltan for help in Brothers In Arms: Novigrad.
Cabaret (L14) -> Carnal Sins (L16) - both auto-start after A Poet Under Pressure; both fail at the Isle of Mists. Carnal Sins pauses the Vegelbud Derby race and postpones the Vegelbud ball.

Redania's Most Wanted (L12) - at least search Philippa's hideout and get the Polished crystal (that alone satisfies Reason of State); do it BEFORE Now or Never so Triss can still look at the crystal; either hand it to Triss fully or do this after Matter of Life.

The Nobleman Statuette (L14, buy figurine in Gildorf) and The Soldier Statuette (L14) - give both to Triss BEFORE Now or Never (afterwards she leaves until Blindingly Obvious; hard cutoff = Ciri's Lodge-meeting objective in Final Preparations).
An Eye for an Eye (L12, Velen/Mulbrydale) - keep Ves alive (needed for Roche in Brothers In Arms). Any time after Get Junior.
Now or Never (L14) - last of the Triss chain: choose rescue/romance; Olivier dies if mages are rescued first; fails at the Isle of Mists.
A Deadly Plot (L14) - auto-starts at the end of Now or Never; Dijkstra at Passiflora first; then Gwent: Playing Thaler (play Thaler right away) / Gwent: Old Pals (Roche at partisan hideout, Thaler).

Gwent: Big City Players - beat Dijkstra before Final Preparations (and at the latest before the Isle of Mists to be safe); High Stakes (L26-scaled, 1,000 crowns, strong deck) any time after Pyres but not during Blindingly Obvious.

Following the Thread (Novigrad/Seven Cats Inn part): do Flesh for Sale (Skellige) before talking to Lambert at the Seven Cats Inn; finish before Ugly Baby (Uma retrieval) which also fails The Last Wish.

Fillers any time (no cutoff vs. story, mostly): Novigrad, Closed City (after Matter of Life), Out On Your Arse! (within a week after Deadly Delights), Rough Neighborhood (after Oxenfurt Drunk), Of Dairy and Darkness, Of Swords and Dumplings, A Feast for Crows, Fists of Fury: Novigrad, Vegelbud Derby, Black Pearl (talk to Nidas at first marker), Little Red, Novigrad Hospitality, Spooked Mare, The Volunteer, Empty Coop, A Barnful of Trouble, Message from an Old Friend, A Tome Entombed, Warehouse of Woe (finish before Reason of State), contracts.

Before sailing for the Isle of Mists: finish Brothers In Arms: Novigrad (Zoltan after A Dangerous Game; Roche after An Eye for an Eye; Dijkstra; Triss after Now or Never); everything listed above with an Isle cutoff must be done: A Dangerous Game, A Deadly Plot, A Matter of Life and Death, An Eye for an Eye, Cabaret, Carnal Sins, Fencing Lessons, Now or Never, Redania's Most Wanted, Brothers In Arms: Novigrad.

After the Isle (post-Bald Mountain): Final Preparations - do Payback, Blindingly Obvious, The Great Escape, Through Time and Space (+ A Final Kindness if applicable); finish any unfinished Statuette quest by going to Triss (Blindingly Obvious) BEFORE the Lodge-meeting objective; let Ciri go alone.
Blindingly Obvious choice: 'I need her' then 'Tell you what the emperor's after if you let us go' to create Reason of State.
It Takes Three to Tango (if both Triss and Yennefer romanced) must be done before Final Preparations ends.

Reason of State (L30) - finish before telling Avallac'h you're ready in On Thin Ice; before it: Warehouse of Woe, Thaler/Roche Gwent; Dijkstra Gwent only if still reachable (it is not after Blindingly Obvious diplomacy until Reason of State ends).

quests.title: Pyres of Novigrad
quests.start: Automatic on first arrival in Novigrad: go to Hierarch Square for the Caleb Menge / Felicia Cori pyre cutscene (after Imperial Audience).

needs_before.why: Wiki lists Imperial Audience as its previous quest.

quests.fails_or_locks_when: never (main quest). Its opening cutscene is what unlocks High Stakes, Witch Hunter Raids, Suspicious Shakedown and The Nobleman Statuette.
quests.mapping_evidence: q301dreamer objectives match the wiki objectives one-to-one: 'Visit Triss in her house', 'Talk to beggars about King of Beggars', 'Look for thieves on main square and carefully track them', 'Find entrance to sewers outside the Novigrad', 'Fight bandits in back entrance', 'Meet King Beggar'. The internal name 'dreamer' is misleading: this file is Pyres, not Novigrad Dreaming.

quests.title: Novigrad Dreaming
quests.start: Automatic: Triss ends Pyres by sending you to oneiromancer Corinne Tilly (house SE of Hierarch Square).
quests.fails_or_locks_when: never. Choice: letting the godling Sarah stay in the house is what makes the side quest Haunted House appear later.
quests.mapping_evidence: q301helpdreamer: 'Find dreamer in old house', 'Search the attic', 'Take the doll', 'Put doll in crib', 'Ask banker about burdock', 'Burn burdock in oven', 'Talk to Dreamer' = wiki walkthrough (rag doll, cradle, burdock, banker Rudolf).

quests.title: Haunted House
quests.start: Only appears if Sarah was allowed to stay in the house during Novigrad Dreaming; Rudolf asks you to come back 'in a week or so'.
quests.fails_or_locks_when: Never appears if Sarah was driven out in Novigrad Dreaming (not recoverable without reload).
quests.mapping_evidence: q301visitingdreamer = 'Visit haunted house' (single objective).

quests.title: Broken Flowers
quests.start: Automatic after Novigrad Dreaming (Corinne names Dandelion): go to Rosemary and Thyme and meet Zoltan.
quests.fails_or_locks_when: never as a quest, but three one-time opportunities live inside it: (a) beat Rosa var Attre in BOTH duels or Fencing Lessons never starts; (b) Zoltan can be played at Gwent here at two points (after reporting back about the women, and while he leaves after meeting Priscilla) - otherwise wait until A Poet Under Pressure; (c) ask Zoltan about the women first so Rosa is on the list (else a bug).
quests.mapping_evidence: q304dandelion has NO objective names in journal_names_2.json (empty list) so it cannot be matched by wording. Assigned by elimination: every other Novigrad main quest (q301*, q302*, q303treasure, q305*) maps to a different file with matching objectives, and Q304 sits numerically between Reuven's Treasure (q303) and Looking for Dandelion (q305). route.py labels this file 'Cabaret', which is wrong: Cabaret is sq303brothel.
unverified: Exact journal file confirmed only by elimination/numbering.

quests.title: Get Junior
quests.start: Automatic after Broken Flowers: go to Sigismund's Bathhouse and talk to Sigi Reuven (Dijkstra / Cleaver / Bedlam meeting).

must_finish_before.why: talk to Cleaver before clearing both arena and casino yourself and before the Redanian-contact scene.

must_finish_before.event: Meeting the Redanian contact (Roche then Radovid at the Oxenfurt Chess Club)
must_finish_before.why: After it the unfinished arena/casino/house objectives and The Gangs of Novigrad all fail. Do not rush: arena, casino, Junior's house can be done in any order first.

quests.fails_or_locks_when: never as a quest, but sub-objectives fail: arena/casino/house objectives you leave open when you reach the Redanian contact; the secret passage into Junior's mansion is closed if you asked about/attacked Junior or used Cleaver's help (arena). Bypassing Radovid's soldiers after leaving Junior's compound (fast travel) leaves A Favor for Radovid / Redania's Most Wanted / A Deadly Plot / Reason of State unstarted.
quests.mapping_evidence: q302mafia objectives: 'Visit Whoreson's ring', 'Use Zdenek's contract to get to the ring', 'Beat your first/third opponent', 'Find and talk to Igor, the Ringleader', 'Kill wild dogs', 'Survive on the ring', 'Visit Whoreson's casino', 'Casino Peacefully' = wiki arena/casino objectives.

quests.title: Ciri's Story: Visiting Junior
quests.start: Starts inside Get Junior when you confront Whoreson Junior in his mansion (Ciri flashback).
quests.fails_or_locks_when: never
quests.mapping_evidence: 'Get on the roof', 'Get to the balcony', 'Get to Whoreson's house through the window', 'Kill Whoreson Junior', 'Escape from Whoreson's house', 'Rescuing Dudu' = wiki walkthrough.

quests.title: A Favor for Radovid
quests.start: Starts and completes automatically when you leave Junior's hideout and Redanian soldiers take you to Radovid's ship (end of Get Junior). Also starts Redania's Most Wanted.

needs_before.why: Previous quest; exit via the front and talk to the soldiers.

quests.fails_or_locks_when: never, but it NEVER TRIGGERS if you bypass the soldiers (fast travel out of the compound); wiki gives console fixes.
quests.mapping_evidence: q302favourforradovid has an empty objective list in journal_names_2.json; matched by name only.

quests.title: Count Reuven's Treasure
quests.start: Talk to Dijkstra in his bathhouse about Dandelion during/after Get Junior (the wiki says you must eventually ask him about Dandelion).

needs_before.why: If you want that side quest it must be started before the witch-hunter outpost section here.

must_finish_before.why: Its Ginter de Lavirac is killed in the background once the outpost section starts.
Play needs both Get Junior and Count Reuven's Treasure completed.

quests.fails_or_locks_when: never. Choice: ask Menge about Dijkstra's treasure (or find the spy's letter) - if you do not ask, Dijkstra refuses the 1,000 crown purse in Brothers In Arms: Novigrad.
quests.mapping_evidence: q303treasure: 'Dijkstra Investigation', 'Drink the Pops' Antidote', 'Examine Dijkstra's dead man', 'Investigate the canal outside the breach area', 'Witch Hunters', 'Report to Dijkstra' = wiki walkthrough (antidote, sewer breach, Menge outpost).

quests.title: The Play's the Thing
quests.start: Talk to Priscilla at the Kingfisher Inn once BOTH Get Junior and Count Reuven's Treasure are finished.

needs_before.why: Needs Dandelion's predicament; both must complete to progress.

must_finish_before.why: Completing the play starts it.

quests.fails_or_locks_when: never. Script genre: drama = riot and killing, comedy = bonus XP. The inn's front door is locked while Now or Never is in progress (back door works).
quests.mapping_evidence: q305theplay: 'Talk to Priscilla', 'Create script', 'Give script', 'Hire thugs from docks', 'Fight strongmen', 'Find jugglers', 'Angry Mob park', 'Start play' = wiki walkthrough.

quests.title: A Poet Under Pressure
quests.start: Automatic after The Play's the Thing; meet Zoltan at the ambush site east of the Seven Cats Inn.

needs_before.why: If you helped Dijkstra find his treasure you can ask him for 3/4/6 men for the ambush.

must_finish_before.why: Cabaret begins automatically when this completes.
Starts via Zoltan after this.

quests.fails_or_locks_when: never. Completing it starts Cabaret, A Dangerous Game and Ciri's Story: Breakneck Speed and puts the Velen notice Envoys, Wineboys on boards.
quests.mapping_evidence: q305lookingfordandelion: 'Prepared Ambush', 'Zoltan Ambush', 'Chase convoy rider', 'Follow scent', 'Enter gnomes passage', 'Kill Witch Hunter', 'Untie Dandelion', 'Dandelion Free' = wiki objectives.

quests.title: Ciri's Story: Breakneck Speed
quests.start: Starts right after A Poet Under Pressure (Ciri flees to Temple Isle).
quests.fails_or_locks_when: never
quests.mapping_evidence: 'Reach Temple', 'Mount second horse', 'End of Dandelion's Story' = wiki.

quests.title: Destination: Skellige
quests.start: Given automatically on completing Imperial Audience; sail from Novigrad harbour (Captain Wolverstone at the Golden Sturgeon).
quests.fails_or_locks_when: never. It unlocks Skellige so Black Pearl (2nd half), Following the Thread (Faroe) and Flesh for Sale can progress.
quests.mapping_evidence: No journal file with matching objectives was found in journal_names_2.json.

quests.title: Brothers In Arms: Novigrad
quests.start: Starts the moment Uma's curse is lifted (end of Va Fail, Elaine) as a sub-quest of The Isle of Mists (journal file lists only 'Quest Started/Quest Ended').

needs_before.why: If not completed BEFORE you ask Zoltan, A Dangerous Game fails instantly and Zoltan gives no optional help.
Roche joins only if it is completed and Ves survived.
Triss gets red marks (and only Yennefer's recruitment covers it) if her Novigrad business is not finished.
You get Dijkstra's 1,000 crown purse + runestones + Tracker's gauntlets diagram only if you asked Menge about his treasure.

must_finish_before.event: The Isle of Mists (boarding the boat)
must_finish_before.why: Brothers In Arms: Novigrad is itself in the Isle of Mists cutoff list.

quests.fails_or_locks_when: Fails when you board the boat for The Isle of Mists. Bug: if you talk to Roche but end the conversation without asking for help, the quest may advance without his help and the option is gone.
quests.mapping_evidence: q402novigradallies has only 'Quest Started'/'Quest Ended' in the journal; it sits beside q402velenallies/q402skelligeallies/q402nilfgaardianally, the other three Brothers In Arms files. Wiki objectives: Talk to Zoltan, Roche, Dijkstra, Triss.

quests.title: Final Preparations
quests.start: Starts immediately after returning from Bald Mountain; umbrella for Through Time and Space, Payback, Blindingly Obvious, The Great Escape (+ A Final Kindness / It Takes Three to Tango when applicable).

must_finish_before.event: Talking to Ciri about the Lodge meeting
must_finish_before.why: That unavoidable objective after Payback + Blindingly Obvious + The Great Escape is the cutoff for both Statuette side quests.

quests.fails_or_locks_when: never as a quest. Side effects: Dijkstra cannot be played at Gwent from the start of this quest; the statuette quests fail at the Lodge-meeting objective; 'let Ciri go in alone' is the positive-ending choice.
quests.mapping_evidence: q310preparationsnovigrad: 'STORY - Chapter 3 - Preparations in Novigrad', 'Q310 Help Yennefer', 'Q310 Help Ciri', 'Q310 Help Triss', 'Q310 Gather Lodge', 'Head back to Dandelion's to meet with the Lodge'.

quests.title: Blindingly Obvious
quests.start: Subquest of Final Preparations: find Triss at the Chameleon (Rosemary and Thyme) after Bald Mountain.

must_finish_before.why: The dialogue 'I need her' then 'Tell you what the emperor's after if you let us go' is the only way to start Reason of State.

quests.fails_or_locks_when: never. Choice at the end decides whether Reason of State exists: forcing past Dijkstra = no Reason of State. Dijkstra becomes unavailable for Gwent until Reason of State ends (if you side with him). Do not start High Stakes while it is active.
quests.mapping_evidence: q310pregeels ('Q310 A Blind Owl'): 'Follow Triss to the Bathhouse', 'Go to Passiflora Gardens for the divination', 'Follow Philippa', 'Make your way to Philippa without making too much noise', 'Go upstairs to meet Triss'.

quests.title: Payback
quests.start: Subquest of Final Preparations: agree to help Ciri (after Through Time and Space, or meet her in Gildorf market in the daytime).
quests.fails_or_locks_when: never (outcome differs if Whoreson Junior was killed vs spared).
quests.mapping_evidence: q310bombing ('Q310 Ciri's Night Out'): 'Q310 Whoreson Dead', 'Q310 Whoreson Alive', 'Q310 Valdo', 'Get on nearby horse and finish the race', 'Follow Ciri to Whoreson'.

quests.title: The Great Escape
quests.start: Subquest of Final Preparations: meet Yennefer at Crippled Kate's.
quests.fails_or_locks_when: never. Prison Warden carries the Gwent cards you skipped in A Dangerous Game; Zoltan stealth approach is unavailable if you completed Now or Never.
quests.mapping_evidence: q310prisonbreak ('Prison Break'): 'Chase the old man', 'Enter the sewers', 'Get the cell door key from the commander's office', 'Return and free the sorceresses', 'Sile left behind / mercy kill'.

quests.title: Through Time and Space
quests.start: Subquest of Final Preparations: talk to Avallac'h about Bald Mountain.
quests.fails_or_locks_when: never
quests.mapping_evidence: q311thespiral ('The Spiral'): 'Dark Valley', 'Tir Na Lia', 'Talk to Ge'els', 'Q311 Ending Geels Convinced'.

quests.title: A Final Kindness
quests.start: Only if Keira's questline was not completed or she left to bargain with Radovid: Triss tells you Keira is impaled at Hierarch Square.

needs_before.why: Keira outcome decides whether it exists.

quests.fails_or_locks_when: never (it simply does not exist if Keira survived with you)
quests.mapping_evidence: q310keira ('Retrieving Keira'): 'Meet Triss on Market Square at night', 'Get rid of the guards', 'Retrieve Keira's body'.

quests.title: It Takes Three to Tango
quests.start: Only if both Triss (Now or Never) and Yennefer (The Last Wish) were romanced: begins after the Lodge meeting during Final Preparations.
quests.fails_or_locks_when: Unavoidable if both romances are active; completing it loses BOTH romances. Must finish before Final Preparations can end.
quests.mapping_evidence: q310romancefailure ('Romantic Disaster'): 'Buy items the girls asked for', 'Meet Triss and Yennefer in Kingfisher Inn'.

quests.title: The Gangs of Novigrad
quests.start: Talk to Cleaver (Carlo Varese) after the bathhouse meeting in Get Junior; he wants you to raze Junior's arena, casino (and tannery).

must_finish_before.event: Meeting Roche's Redanian contact in Get Junior
must_finish_before.why: Quest fails (and the unfinished arena/casino objectives with it) once you meet the Redanian contact.

quests.fails_or_locks_when: Fails when the Redanian contact is met in Get Junior (Radovid at the Oxenfurt Chess Club; the wiki also says 'last chance to explore' at the Roche meeting step, so treat Dijkstra->Roche as the effective cutoff). Also fails if you stray too far from the casino/arena after talking to Cleaver's dwarves. If you clear BOTH locations yourself before speaking to Cleaver you cannot talk to him (stuck at 'Think over Cleaver's offer'); if you clear both but have not searched them he can still be talked to but the quest fails with 200 XP.
quests.mapping_evidence: q302war: 'Talk to Cleaver', 'Rethink Cleaver's offer', 'Trash Whoreson's ring', 'Trash Whoreson's casino', 'Trash Whoreson's tannery', 'Report back to Cleaver', 'Meet with dwarves casino/ring' = wiki Gangs of Novigrad. This is the only Novigrad quest where route.py's file is correct.
unverified: Exact trigger: wiki text is ambiguous between the Roche-camp step and the Chess Club cutscene; conservative reading used.

quests.title: Honor Among Thieves
quests.start: Free the beaten halfling spy (Rico Meiersdorf) on the casino top floor during Get Junior; then collect from the King of Beggars at Putrid Grove.
quests.fails_or_locks_when: never
quests.mapping_evidence: q302debt: 'King Beggar's Debt', 'Talk to King Beggar about freed Rico'.

quests.title: A Walk on the Waterfront
quests.start: Proximity quest at Novigrad Harborside (nobleman Ginter de Lavirac threatened by suppliers). Disappears if you see it and walk away.

must_finish_before.why: Ginter is killed in the background; quest no longer available.

quests.fails_or_locks_when: Fails if Ginter dies; unavailable once the outpost section of Count Reuven's Treasure starts.
quests.mapping_evidence: mq3005badalley is titled 'mq3005 Shady Deal' in the game files, with objectives 'Follow the noble' and 'Defeat the bandits'. That matches the wiki story (escort the nobleman through the harbour bandits to his supplier). The in-game title differs from the wiki name.
unverified: Journal file matched by its objectives, not by an exact title.

quests.title: A Matter of Life and Death
quests.start: Talk to Triss in her hideout (boarding house, The Bits) after Count Reuven's Treasure; she gets a letter from Lady Ingrid Vegelbud.

needs_before.why: If Carnal Sins is active and you have not yet visited the Vegelbud estate, Triss postpones the ball: finish the Vegelbud part of Carnal Sins first or do this quest before Carnal Sins starts.

must_finish_before.why: Now or Never starts only after A Favor for Radovid AND this quest.

must_finish_before.event: The Isle of Mists (boarding the boat)
must_finish_before.why: Listed in the Isle cutoff list.

quests.fails_or_locks_when: Fails at The Isle of Mists. The Vegelbud Gwent tournament (3 players, 3 unique cards + the Dandelion card) is only available during the ball; losing is free (replay until win) but not finishing all three means Collect 'Em All can never complete.
quests.mapping_evidence: sq301triss: 'Meet Triss in her hideout', 'Join Triss', 'Meet Ingrid Vegelbud', 'SQ301 Fail on masquerade', 'SQ301 Fail on Fishmarket' = wiki objectives (servant at fish market, masquerade, Ingrid, fail states).

quests.title: Novigrad, Closed City
quests.start: Appears after A Matter of Life and Death during the witch-hunter crackdown: a gate guard gives you a pass; Lussi (St. Gregory's Bridge), Wallter (behind Crippled Kate's), Fritz (east of Triss' hideout) give three safe keys. Part II (bandits) is a separate journal entry.

needs_before.quest: A Matter of Life and Death
needs_before.why: 'Becomes available only after it is completed'.

quests.fails_or_locks_when: never listed. Sub-events (Moritz at Glory Gate, Wallter) are time-sensitive relative to Now or Never. If A Matter of Life and Death is done before Contract: Deadly Delights you will meet Wallter during that contract.
quests.mapping_evidence: q309novigradundercontrol: 'Helping woman', 'Three parts of key', 'Find safe keys match', 'Open safe'; ...control2: 'Look for his trails', 'Follow trails and find missing', 'Kill bandits' = Lussi/Wallter/Fritz keys + the Part II bandits.

quests.title: Redania's Most Wanted
quests.start: Starts automatically from A Favor for Radovid (Radovid orders you to find Philippa); go to Est Tayiar (Oxenfurt harbour) and talk to the witch hunters.

must_finish_before.why: If the crystal is found after Now or Never, Triss can no longer be shown it.

must_finish_before.event: The Isle of Mists (boarding the boat)
must_finish_before.why: In the Isle cutoff list.

quests.fails_or_locks_when: Fails at The Isle of Mists. For Reason of State the real requirement is only: search Philippa's hideout and obtain the Polished crystal; you may then fail the rest (do not report to Radovid) without locking Reason of State. Showing the crystal to Triss but not giving it can bug the Vegelbud servant in A Matter of Life and Death.
quests.mapping_evidence: sq302philippa: 'Q302 Found Crystal', 'Q302 Crystal to Yen', 'Q302 Crystal to Triss', 'Q302 Return to Radowid - give crystal', 'SQ302 Fail without going to hideout', 'Take crystal from Philippa's megas' = wiki objectives (Open Philippa's hideout, Search, crystal, Talk to Triss/Yennefer, Tell Radovid). route.py wrongly uses this file for An Eye for an Eye.

quests.title: An Eye for an Eye
quests.start: Starts at the end of Get Junior: Roche asks for help regarding Ves (meet Roche by Hanged Man's Tree, Velen; Ves is attacked in Mulbrydale).

must_finish_before.why: Roche joins Kaer Morhen only if this is completed and Ves survives.

must_finish_before.event: The Isle of Mists (boarding the boat)
must_finish_before.why: In the Isle cutoff list.

quests.fails_or_locks_when: Fails at The Isle of Mists, or immediately if Ves dies. Letting it fail does not lock Reason of State (only having obtained it matters) but costs Roche's help at Kaer Morhen.
quests.mapping_evidence: sq312vincentves: 'Meet Roche', 'Find Roche', 'Don't Let Ves Die', 'Meet with Roche in his camp' = wiki objectives 'Meet Roche at his camp', 'Meet Roche by Hanged Man's Tree', 'Save Ves'. route.py wrongly uses sq302philippa.

quests.title: Now or Never
quests.start: Talk to Triss (Kingfisher Inn boarding house) after BOTH A Favor for Radovid and A Matter of Life and Death are done; if you did them in another order a perfumed letter arrives.

needs_before.quest: A Matter of Life and Death

needs_before.why: Get the crystal first: after Now or Never Triss cannot be shown it.
Triss leaves Novigrad after this (unless romanced and kept); statuette quests then wait until Blindingly Obvious.
Olivier dies here if you rescue the mages first; his card then lies in a lockbox (fail-safe exists).

must_finish_before.why: A Deadly Plot starts automatically via Dijkstra at the port at the end of this quest.

must_finish_before.event: The Isle of Mists (boarding the boat)
must_finish_before.why: In the Isle cutoff list.

quests.fails_or_locks_when: Fails at The Isle of Mists. Completing it ends Witch Hunter Raids and removes the ability to use Zoltan for the stealth approach in The Great Escape. Romance with Triss here (kiss/lighthouse) also ties to It Takes Three to Tango if Yennefer is romanced.
